Company: Finlytics Pvt Ltd
Role: Software Engineer II
Dates: Apr 2021 - Present
Location: Pune, India (hybrid)
Team: Settlements and Payouts team, 6 engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager
Product: Settlement and payout platform that moves money to about 12,000 merchants for UPI and card payments
What I did:
- Owned the merchant settlements service end to end: design, development, deployment, monitoring and on-call
- Designed and built a Kafka-based settlement event pipeline in Python that replaced a nightly batch job, cutting payout status delay from up to 24 hours to under 1 minute
- Scaled the settlement consumers to about 2 million events per day at peak with consumer groups and partition-based parallelism
- Added retry with exponential backoff and a dead-letter topic so failed settlement events were never lost; replay tool brought back 100% of failed events
- Made payment event processing idempotent using unique event keys in PostgreSQL, removing duplicate payouts caused by redelivered messages
- Built REST APIs in FastAPI for settlements, payouts and merchant reports, used by 3 internal teams and the merchant dashboard
- Wrote OpenAPI specs and versioned the payouts API (v1 to v2) without breaking existing clients
- Reduced payouts API p99 latency from 2.1s to 450ms at month-end peaks by caching merchant configuration in Redis and removing N+1 queries
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas for settlement records, ledger entries and payout batches, including partitioning of the settlements table by month
- Tuned slow reporting queries from 40s to 6s using composite indexes and EXPLAIN ANALYZE
- Built a daily bank reconciliation job that matches bank statement files from S3 with settlement records and flags mismatches, cutting manual finance work from 3 hours to 20 minutes a day
- Worked with finance and compliance teams on audit requirements and added an append-only audit log for every payout state change
- Moved 9 cron batch jobs to Celery workers on AWS with retries, timeouts and failure alerts
- Containerized services with Docker and deployed them to Kubernetes (AWS EKS) using Helm charts
- Set up CI pipelines in GitHub Actions for tests, linting and Docker image builds; deploy time went from about 40 minutes to 12 minutes
- Built Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts for API latency, error rates and Kafka consumer lag
- Took part in the on-call rotation (1 week in 6) and wrote runbooks for the 5 most common payout incidents
- Led the root-cause analysis for a month-end payout delay incident and shipped fixes that prevented repeats over the next 12 months
- Raised test coverage of the reconciliation module from 45% to 82% with pytest unit and integration tests using Testcontainers
- Mentored 2 junior engineers through onboarding, pairing sessions and weekly code reviews
- Led 3 technical design reviews for the payouts module and wrote the design docs
- Worked with product managers to break down the instant payouts feature into milestones and delivered it in 2 quarters
- Raised test coverage of the payment reconciliation module from 45% to 82% using pytest unit and integration tests with Testcontainers, reducing manual finance work from 3 hours to 20 minutes per day.
- Built Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts to monitor API latency, error rates, and Kafka consumer lag for a settlement pipeline handling approximately 2 million events per day during on-call rotations.
- Increased test coverage from 45% to 82%
- Reduced manual finance work from 3 hours to 20 minutes daily

Company: CartNest
Role: Software Engineer
Dates: Jul 2019 - Mar 2021
Location: Pune, India
Team: Orders team, 5 engineers
Product: E-commerce marketplace for home and kitchen products with web and Android apps
What I did:
- Built and maintained Django services for order management handling about 20,000 orders per day
- Designed the order state machine (placed, packed, shipped, delivered, returned) and its REST APIs
- Integrated 3 shipping partner APIs for label creation, pickup booking and tracking
- Built webhook handling for shipping updates with retries and idempotency keys, which stopped duplicate shipment updates
- Wrote order tracking REST APIs used by the web and Android apps
- Maintained Redis caching for product catalogue pages with a cache hit rate of about 90%
- Moved email and SMS notifications to Celery background tasks, cutting checkout API response time by about 35%
- Built the returns and refunds flow with the payments team, including partial refunds
- Optimized MySQL queries on the orders table and added indexes for the seller dashboard
- Dockerized the order service and 2 related services for the move to AWS ECS
- Added Sentry error tracking and structured logging to the order services
- Supported 2 big sale events (Diwali) with load testing in Locust and capacity planning
- Wrote unit tests with pytest and set up Jenkins jobs to run them on every merge request
